description: Answers: what did public companies just tell the SEC? Corporate events from the SEC's live filing feed, within about 15 minutes of the SEC accepting each filing: earnings releases (with the press release link), CEO/CFO and director changes, shareholder vote results, deals closed, material agreements, auditor changes and restatements, cybersecurity incidents, bankruptcies, delisting notices, restructurings, and 10-Q/10-K reports. Each event has the company, ticker, the SEC item code, the time the SEC accepted it, and the official SEC link. Filter by type, ticker or time. Free, CC BY 4.0. Reporting, not investment advice.

since.description: optional ISO time; only events the SEC accepted after it

type.description: optional, comma-separated: earnings, leadership, vote-results, deal-completed, control-change, agreement, auditor, restatement, cyber, bankruptcy, delisting, restructuring, impairment, quarterly-report, annual-report (full list at https://www.pops4.com/boards/now/types.json)
